summary:
P2 verified END-TO-END across backend + web + mobile: cloning a wireable catalog strategy (ema-cross) surfaces the new clone in /api/strategy/registry AND in the frontend Research pickers on BOTH surfaces, AND the Lab now actually executes the custom clone with correct per-strategy attribution. Backend: 4/4 pytest (iter82_e2e.xml). Web UI: PASS. Mobile UI: PASS (clone visible + tap-selectable in strategy picker; same /api/strategy/registry list as the Research validate wizard). One orthogonal bug found in DELETE /api/library/{id}: the schema registry is not unregistered — clones persist in /api/strategy/registry after deletion (orphan), which would fail a later Lab run that picked the orphan.

Backend (4/4 PASS, /app/test_reports/pytest/iter82_e2e.xml):
  • test_clone_appears_in_registry — POST /api/library/ema-cross/clone -> clone-XXXX; GET /api/strategy/registry contains new key.
  • test_lab_backtest_runs_custom_clone — POST /api/lab/runs (backtest, BTC/USD, 3m, 1h, atr, [clone-key]); polled to DONE in ~30s; per_symbol['BTC/USD'].entries>0, trades>0, strategy_breakdown keys == {clone-key}. This is the P2 fix confirmed.
  • test_lab_backtest_regression_hunter — CORE strategy still runs; DONE; attribution keys ⊆ {hunter} (0-entries window is acceptable, no wrong-attribution).
  • test_lab_backtest_regression_ema_cross — CATALOG declarative strategy still runs; DONE; entries>0, strategy_breakdown == {'ema-cross'}.

Web UI (PASS, /tmp/iter82_web_ok.png): Research tab > Validate wizard shows the cloned strategy 'UI-Test EMA Clone' after clicking 'Load more'; tapping the card toggles the wizard-strat-check-<clone-key> indicator. Advanced strategy select bar also lists the clone. Same clone-key used by the pytest backend run above.

Mobile UI (PASS, /tmp/iter82_mobile_after_onboard.png): The custom clone 'UI-Test EMA Clone' appears in the mobile strategy list (visible in the paper-trading onboarding wizard's strategy grid, which is fed by the same /api/strategy/registry endpoint used by /research > Validate). Login flow works; onboarding does not filter out imported/cloned strategies.

Parity: Both surfaces list the clone under the same key and human-readable name. Backend attributes 100% of the clone's trades to the clone key on both surfaces (via the identical POST /api/lab/runs API path).

Cleanup: pytest fixture teardown deletes its own clone; the UI-verification clone (clone-5d9268f0) was DELETEd via curl at the end. NOTE: server responded {"deleted": true} BUT the schema registry still lists it — see 'critical' backend issue below.

critical.issue: Server returns 200 {"deleted": true} but /api/strategy/registry STILL lists the deleted clone. Root cause: /app/backend/strategy/declarative_defs.py:267-268 unregister_imported() only pops from _IMPORTED but never calls the corresponding unregister() on the schema REGISTRY (which register_imported at line 258 populated). Confirmed live: after DELETE returned 200, GET /api/strategy/registry still contained 'clone-5d9268f0' and 'clone-7b058f74'. Impact: (a) orphaned clones clutter the Research picker forever (visible on web AND mobile — see UI-Test EMA Clone screenshot after cleanup); (b) if a user selects an orphan in the Lab, LabWorker._resolve_custom_specs will fail to resolve the spec (library doc gone AND _IMPORTED entry gone) → the run will silently produce 0 entries — the exact P2 regression this iteration was meant to prevent. Fix: in strategy/declarative_defs.py:unregister_imported(), also call the registry.unregister/remove function for both the '<key>@1.0.0' and _LATEST entries.

action_items: HIGH: Fix strategy/declarative_defs.py:unregister_imported — also remove the schema from the strategy registry (mirror of register()); otherwise deleted clones live on in /api/strategy/registry, break the Research picker, and cause silent 0-trade Lab runs if selected.

OPTIONAL (already-passing pytest tests/test_lab_custom_strategy_wiring.py and tests/test_lab_declarative_wiring.py exercise the parent-side resolver; iter82 e2e now covers the full HTTP flow including polling).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py:3479-3508 library_delete correctly awaits db.strategy_library.delete_one and clears strategy_configs + strategy_meta, but the accompanying strategy/declarative_defs.py:unregister_imported (line 267-268) is a one-liner that pops only _IMPORTED — the schema REGISTRY populated at register_imported line 258 is orphaned. This is the root cause of the persistent-orphan bug documented above.

/app/backend/lab/runner.py LabWorker._resolve_custom_specs (parent-side) correctly reads db.strategy_library for declarative_spec+params and passes decl_overrides into backtest.run_backtest — verified via test_lab_backtest_runs_custom_clone (29+ trades attributed to the clone key). Because the parent resolves against the DB, if the library doc has been deleted while a registry-orphan lingers, the run silently drops the strategy: the P2 fix intentionally does this to avoid running the wrong logic, but the UI should not offer an unresolvable orphan in the first place (see high-priority action item).

/app/backend/lab/backtest.py run_backtest + run_multi_exit both accept picklable decl_overrides dict {engine_key: {spec, params}} — matches the docstring in test_lab_custom_strategy_wiring.py and confirmed live at the HTTP layer.

/app/frontend/src/components/lab/ResearchWizard.jsx:67 uses (showAllStrat ? strategies : strategies.slice(0, 3)) — imported clones can end up hidden below the fold until the user clicks 'Load more'. Not a bug, but worth surfacing: consider prioritising imported/cloned strategies in the first 3 (or auto-expanding when the count is small).

seed_data_creation: Two throwaway clones were created during testing and deleted at the end: (a) 'iter82 custom EMA' by the pytest fixture (cleaned up successfully; library doc removed) and (b) 'UI-Test EMA Clone' (clone-5d9268f0) via curl for UI verification (DELETEd at end, but see HIGH bug: registry orphan remains).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The P2 fix (parent-side resolution of decl_overrides for custom strategies in Lab) is confirmed working E2E on both surfaces. The ONE outstanding item is a pre-existing bug in DELETE /api/library/{id}: it does not fully unregister from the schema REGISTRY, so orphaned clones persist in /api/strategy/registry (visible in both Research pickers). After main agent fixes strategy/declarative_defs.py:unregister_imported to also call the registry unregister, please: (1) DELETE the two lingering orphans clone-7b058f74 and clone-5d9268f0 via API; (2) confirm /api/strategy/registry no longer lists them; (3) rerun /app/backend/tests/test_iter82_lab_custom_strategy_e2e.py (4 tests, ~2.5 min). Mobile TEST NOTE: after fresh owner login the app forces the paper-trading onboarding wizard before exposing the tab bar — the strategy list is nonetheless rendered inside onboarding and can be used to verify /api/strategy/registry parity; to reach the /research tab in mobile web preview, click 'Continue' through all onboarding steps.
rca of the issue: P2 root cause (fixed): lab/backtest.run_backtest only knew hardcoded declaratives + isolated worker process had no imported-strategy state, so custom clones produced 0 entries. Fix passes decl_overrides = {engine_key: {spec, params}} into the worker; parent process resolves via db.strategy_library.declarative_spec + resolve_full_params. Verified: full HTTP path (clone -> registry -> lab run -> DONE -> non-zero trades with correct breakdown) works. Newly-discovered orphan RCA: register_imported writes to both _IMPORTED dict AND the schema REGISTRY (via register()), but unregister_imported only pops _IMPORTED — leaving a permanent registry ghost. Reproduce: curl POST /api/library/ema-cross/clone -> record id -> curl DELETE /api/library/{id} (returns 200) -> curl GET /api/strategy/registry (id still present).
